title: Stuibenfall Umhausen Oetztal
highlights: Hoechster Wasserfall Tirols mit einer gigantischen Fallhoehe von 159 Metern
Spektakulaere Treppenkonstruktion mit 700 Stufen und einer 80 Meter langen Haengebruecke
Fuenf exponierte Aussichtsplattformen direkt an der tosenden Wasserstaub-Kaskade
Familienfreundlicher Klettersteig entlang der tosenden Wassermassen
kurzbeschreibung: Plunging 159 metres, the Stuibenfall in Umhausen is Tyrol's highest waterfall, accessible via 700 steps and a suspension bridge.
beschreibung:
Tyrol's Most Majestic Natural Spectacle

With a drop of 159 metres, the Stuibenfall in Umhausen is the highest waterfall in the province of Tyrol. This natural spectacle was formed around 9,000 years ago following a colossal rockslide that dammed the Horlachbach and forced it into a new riverbed over precipitous rock faces.

Daring Walkway Through the Water Mist

An architecturally award-winning trail structure comprising 700 steps and an airy suspension bridge brings visitors up close to the roaring spray. From the five viewing platforms, hikers can enjoy the fine water mist, whose ionized air has a proven beneficial effect on the respiratory tract.
